Now let's start the build. First, demospipes base (api and core), then the bmds addons (the FROM lines need to be replaced with local tags). After that, frontend, and then all the remaining backends.

Memory: 7.6Gi total, 8 CPUs. Building 30+ images in parallel is too much. I'll build them sequentially in the background, but keep the number of concurrent builds low (to be safe, 1-2 at a time; uv sync downloads a lot of packages and some builds are heavy (like torch for dokumentenaufbereitung-monorepo)).

Plan:
1. Build demospipes base: `docker build -t demospipes-base-api -f 02-backend/demospipes/api/Dockerfile .` (context is /workspace).
2. Build demospipes core the same way → demospipes-base-executors.
3. Replace the FROM lines in the bmds addons with the local tags, then build them from the /workspace root context.
4. Build frontend.
5. Build all the remaining backend services.
6. Build the 03-shared-services/ki-validierung image.

Note that the demospipes core's builder uses `pip wheel ... --extra-index-url "https://user:pass@<REDACTED>"`. With dummy credentials, pip will try to connect to that URL and fail with DNS error → the build will fail unless I modify the Dockerfile. The guide says to replace `<REDACTED>` with a domain of your choice or localhost. I'll deal with it if I get there: remove the extra-index-url argument from these 3 Dockerfiles (the demospipes core, bmds api, bmds executors) — all the dependencies are on PyPI (prefect, fastapi, aiohttp, pydantic, etc.), so this is a reasonable public-equivalent fix. Actually, I should test it: will pip fail on an invalid extra-index-url, or just emit a warning? It'll fail: "Could not fetch URL ... There was a problem confirming the ssl certificate" or "DNS lookup failed". Let's actually test it quickly in a container — I'll build demospipes/core and see what happens.

Actually, let me preemptively test connectivity first. The URL is `<REDACTED>` — literally a placeholder, not a resolvable host. DNS lookup will fail. pip will raise an error. So the build will fail unless I modify it. The guide says "replace with a domain of your choice" — a literal interpretation: replace the `<REDACTED>` in the pip URL with a domain. If I replace it with, say, `localhost`, pip will try https://user:pass@localhost/simple — connection refused → also fails. The only "domain" that works is one that serves the needed packages — i.e., PyPI. So the practical public equivalent is to use https://pypi.org/simple, or simply drop the extra-index-url. Both are justifiable under the guide's placeholder replacement rules. I'll go with dropping the --extra-index-url flag (cleaner, avoids credentials in the URL).

Hmm, wait, let me reconsider: I should first build and observe the actual failure, then apply the fix, and document that. That's the most evidence-based approach. But the demospipes core build will take a few minutes to reach that stage (uv sync in the test-deps stage). To save time, I'll just test pip's behavior quickly in a container first.

Actually, the fastest evidence is: `pip install --extra-index-url "https://user:pass@<REDACTED>/simple" something`. I'll run this in a container right away.
